title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Brother Asalam Alaikum In a Islamic Name Book I saw a name Ribah , companion of our Prophet. I was inspired with this name and put the name Riba Enterprises to my new form company. I registered the firm and completed all government formalities. Now I come to know that the meaning of this word is interest which is looking very unislamic . I am upset very much . Although in my mind ( niyat ) it was Islamic . At this stage I am not in a position to change the name . Brother let me know what is the effect of name , it context , what should be answer if some one ask about the name, in respect to keep my niyat in mind.. Yours truly! 1675 views Q. اصفا فاطمہ (Aasfa fathima) نام کے بارے میں بتائیں۔کیا یہ نام شریعت کی روشنی میں درست ہے؟براہ کرم، کوئی ایسا نام بتائیں جو بہت زیادہ اچھا ہو اور اس کے بہت سارے فضائل ہوں۔ میں اپنی بیٹی کا نام رکھنا چاہتاہوں جو کل پیدا ہوئی ہے۔ 1764 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41715 Country: India Title: My wife is blessed with baby girl around 2 and half months back named her as "Sarah Manha". Please let me know is this name good for her Question: My wife is blessed with baby girl around 2 and half months back named her as "Sarah Manha". Please let me know is this name good for her? Answer ID: 41715 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1835/1414/B=1433) Keep only the name ‘Sarah’, it is a good name. It was the name of the wife of Hadhrat Ibrahim (عليه السلام). Do not add the word Manha. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
